                    阅读9分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">Konva.js 多维表格系统</h2>
<p>基于 <strong>Konva.js</strong> 实现的高性能「多维表格系统」，支持大规模渲染、分组管理、筛选与排序等复杂功能，旨在构建类似腾讯文档 / 飞书多维表格的交互体验。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">目录</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="#%E4%B8%80%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E6%A6%82%E8%BF%B0" title="#%E4%B8%80%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E6%A6%82%E8%BF%B0">一、项目概述</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E4%BA%8C%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E6%B8%85%E5%8D%95" title="#%E4%BA%8C%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E6%B8%85%E5%8D%95">二、功能清单</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E4%B8%89%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1" title="#%E4%B8%89%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1">三、核心架构设计</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%9B%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E" title="#%E5%9B%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E">四、模块说明</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E4%BA%94%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E6%9C%BA%E5%88%B6" title="#%E4%BA%94%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E6%9C%BA%E5%88%B6">五、关键机制</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%85%AD%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B" title="#%E5%85%AD%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B">六、实现过程</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E4%B8%83%E6%80%A7%E8%83%BD%E4%BC%98%E5%8C%96" title="#%E4%B8%83%E6%80%A7%E8%83%BD%E4%BC%98%E5%8C%96">七、性能优化</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%85%AB%E6%89%A9%E5%B1%95%E6%80%A7" title="#%E5%85%AB%E6%89%A9%E5%B1%95%E6%80%A7">八、扩展</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E4%B9%9D%E7%BB%93%E8%AF%AD" title="#%E4%B9%9D%E7%BB%93%E8%AF%AD">九、结语</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">一、项目概述</h3>
<p>本项目使用 <strong>Konva.js</strong> 实现一个高性能的二维/多维表格系统，支持：</p>
<ul>
<li>大规模表格渲染（行列可达数百万级）</li>
<li>按分组管理的数据展示</li>
<li>多维度筛选与排序</li>
<li>支持图片、文本、状态标签等多类型单元格</li>
<li>响应式布局与虚拟滚动优化</li>
</ul>
<p>该系统适用于「任务管理」「资源调度」「项目需求规划」等复杂表格场景。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">二、功能清单</h3>













































<table><thead><tr><th>功能模块</th><th>描述</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>表格渲染</td><td>基于 Konva Layer + Group 分层渲染，实现单元格、边框、背景高效绘制</td></tr><tr><td>分组管理</td><td>支持按分类分组显示，组可展开/折叠</td></tr><tr><td>筛选功能</td><td>支持多列字段条件过滤（文本、数值、状态）</td></tr><tr><td>排序功能</td><td>支持单列与多列排序逻辑</td></tr><tr><td>单元格类型</td><td>文本、图片、状态标签、自定义渲染器</td></tr><tr><td>交互操作</td><td>选中、框选、多选、悬浮提示、滚动同步</td></tr><tr><td>虚拟滚动优化</td><td>仅渲染视口内元素，提升渲染性能</td></tr><tr><td>动态布局</td><td>自适应行高、列宽及容器尺寸变化</td></tr><tr><td>批量更新机制</td><td>使用 requestAnimationFrame 实现批量绘制，避免重复渲染</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">三、核心架构设计</h3>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d621afc607434cbc8e1f00360ca5fe44~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=BrFWy2RNcbsajLZXP7gVzLyWW1w%3D" alt="image.png" width="50%" loading="lazy">
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown"><span class="hljs-section">## 🎯 主控制器</span>

</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">四、模块说明</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">1. Renderer 模块</h4>
<p>负责表格的可视化渲染逻辑：</p>
<ul>
<li>使用 <code>Konva.Layer</code> 管理背景层、内容层、交互层</li>
<li>每一行或一组单元格使用 <code>Konva.Group</code> 表示</li>
<li>支持增量渲染与批量更新</li>
<li>通过矩阵坐标快速定位渲染区域</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">2. Model 模块</h4>
<ul>
<li>提供数据源抽象</li>
<li>支持筛选、排序、分组聚合与动态更新</li>
<li>通过观察者模式与渲染层同步数据变更</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">3. Controller 模块</h4>
<ul>
<li>监听用户输入事件（鼠标、滚动、拖拽）</li>
<li>控制渲染队列与更新节奏</li>
<li>管理当前选中状态与焦点单元格</li>
<li>与 Model 层进行数据同步</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">五、关键机制</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">1. 分组渲染（Group Rendering）</h4>
<ul>
<li>每个分组独立使用一个 <code>Konva.Group</code></li>
<li>折叠后仅渲染组头</li>
<li>展开时批量加载子节点</li>
<li>支持懒加载以优化性能</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">2. 虚拟滚动（Virtual Scrolling）</h4>
<ul>
<li>计算可视区域内应渲染的行列</li>
<li>减少内存占用与重绘次数</li>
<li>支持横向与纵向滚动同步</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-12">3. 批量绘制（Batch Draw）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> _waitingForDraw = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-attr">animQueue</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Function</span>[] = [];

<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">batchDraw</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimationFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">fn</span> =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fn</span>());
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span> = [];
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
    });
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">六、实现过程</h3>
<h5 data-id="heading-14">1. konva.js实现一个简单的表格绘制 但是这样太过于简单了 如果行列数量巨大且需要扩展显示 卡顿的比较严重。</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">   <span class="hljs-comment">// 绘制表格</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> row = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; row &lt; <span class="hljs-number">10</span>; row++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> col = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; col &lt; <span class="hljs-number">10</span>; col++) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建每个单元格</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rect = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>({
          <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: col * cellSize,
          <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: row * cellSize,
          <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: cellSize,
          <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: cellSize,
          <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'lightgrey'</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'black'</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
        });

        <span class="hljs-comment">// 将矩形添加到图层</span>
        layer.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(rect);
      }
    }
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-15">2.使用辅助类 <code>VirtualTableHelpers</code> 这个类中提供了一系列的函数，如下图。通过offsetY和offsetX  以及 rowHeight colWidth 我们可以计算出当前可视区域 应该渲染哪些row 和 column。</h5>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/df9519b67d2a435ebb108f5aa25b4ad4~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=7xKkrsEyaJUsGvEziwXn%2BavPQWs%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-title function_">getVisibleRowRange</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">frozenRowsHeight</span>: number): { <span class="hljs-attr">start</span>: number; <span class="hljs-attr">end</span>: number } {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rowCount = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">linearRowsManager</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowCount</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> viewportHeight = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibleHeight</span> - frozenRowsHeight - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollBarSize</span>;
    <span class="hljs-comment">//  使用二分查找找到起始行（O(log n)）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> startRow = <span class="hljs-title class_">VirtualTableHelpers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowStartIndexForOffset</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">itemType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"row"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowHeight</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getRowHeight</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getColumnWidth</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowCount</span>: rowCount,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnCount</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cols</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">instanceProps</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instanceProps</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">offset</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollY</span>
    });
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 基于起始行计算结束行（增量计算）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> endRow = <span class="hljs-title class_">VirtualTableHelpers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowStopIndexForStartIndex</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">startIndex</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenRows</span>, startRow),
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowCount</span>: rowCount,
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowHeight</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getRowHeight</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getColumnWidth</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">scrollTop</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollY</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">containerHeight</span>: viewportHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">instanceProps</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instanceProps</span>
    });
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 添加缓冲区（预渲染上下各 2 行）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-number">2</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
      <span class="hljs-attr">start</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenRows</span>, startRow - buffer),
      <span class="hljs-attr">end</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(rowCount - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, endRow + buffer)
    };
  }
  
   <span class="hljs-title function_">getVisibleColRange</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">frozenColsWidth</span>: number): { <span class="hljs-attr">start</span>: number; <span class="hljs-attr">end</span>: number } {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> viewportWidth = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibleWidth</span> - frozenColsWidth - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollBarSize</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> startCol = <span class="hljs-title class_">VirtualTableHelpers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getColumnStartIndexForOffset</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">itemType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"column"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowHeight</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getRowHeight</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getColumnWidth</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowCount</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">rows</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnCount</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cols</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">instanceProps</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instanceProps</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">offset</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollX</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> endCol = <span class="hljs-title class_">VirtualTableHelpers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getColumnStopIndexForStartIndex</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">startIndex</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenCols</span>, startCol),
      <span class="hljs-attr">rowHeight</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getRowHeight</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">getColumnWidth</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">instanceProps</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instanceProps</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">containerWidth</span>: viewportWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">scrollLeft</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollX</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">columnCount</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cols</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-number">2</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
      <span class="hljs-attr">start</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenCols</span>, startCol - buffer),
      <span class="hljs-attr">end</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cols</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, endCol + buffer)
    };
  }
  
      <span class="hljs-comment">//   渲染一下即可看到效果</span>
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 渲染单元格 - 从 leftPadding 开始</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> row = visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">start</span>; row &lt;= visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">end</span>; row++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> height = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowHeight</span>(row);

      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (currentY + height &gt;= frozenRowsHeight &amp;&amp;
        currentY &lt;= <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibleHeight</span> - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollBarSize</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> currentX = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">leftPadding</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> col = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; col &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenCols</span>; col++) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getColumnWidth</span>(col);
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cell = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createCell</span>(row, col, currentX, currentY, width, height);
          <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomLeft</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(cell);
          currentX += width;
        }
      }

      currentY += height;
    }
  }
</code></pre>
<h6 data-id="heading-16">填充一点数据即可 到这里一个高性能的表格也就成了 但是我们是要实现多维表格 还有段距离。</h6>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d7341f6f80614b26947e7d294aa9602f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=NkHnl%2BgK49o8oEWIuYGBm05m%2BhA%3D" alt="1542b9069949c52aa4649c42d77f5cfd.png" width="50%" loading="lazy">
<h5 data-id="heading-17">3. 画布分层 以及 兼容冻结行列。（<code> 相对有点难度</code> ）</h5>
<ul>
<li>使用 bodyLayer更新不那么频繁且渲染成本较高， 渲染 静态表格数据。 使用featureLayer渲染 用户选区，横纵滚动条，高亮等等用户交互。</li>
<li>为什么这样做 ： bodyLayer更新不那么频繁且渲染成本较高，featureLayer更新渲染非常频繁，bodyLayer不受影响。</li>
<li>我们定义一个<code>Canvas</code>类专门处理画布，首先创建画布</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-title function_">setupLayers</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">backgroundLayer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Layer</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'backgroundLayer'</span> });
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bodyLayer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Layer</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'bodyLayer'</span> });
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">featureLayer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Layer</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'featureLayer'</span> });

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">stage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">backgroundLayer</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bodyLayer</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">featureLayer</span>);
   }
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p>接下来就是处理冻结行列，冻结行列我计划分成四块区域 ｜ 或者说四个组 来渲染，如图，区域 ｜ 组可以使用layer ｜ group来划分，这里我采用konva.group来划分，因为官网说了不建议过多的layer。
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/1f0806ccf30f4e59be57d71a921b90e3~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=F%2BADcbe5w3UTFerNlcrXvMYJHUU%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>固定行冻结为一列 列假设设置成4列 计算出冻结区域</strong> 这样我们就为每一个group确定了应有的宽高，拖动行列滚动条的时候 就只需要更新 右下角的group就可以了，也需要重新计算bottomRight可视区域内的行列起始行列，为什么不需要处理其他三个区域呢 因为冻结不能冻结超出屏幕以外的行列。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">    <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建四个分组</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span> = {
      <span class="hljs-attr">topLeft</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>(),
      <span class="hljs-attr">topRight</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>(),
      <span class="hljs-attr">bottomLeft</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>(),
      <span class="hljs-attr">bottomRight</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>(),
    };

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bodyLayer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(...<span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">values</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span>))
    
    裁剪一下实现冻结的效果
   <span class="hljs-title function_">setClipping</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> frozenColsWidth = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">core</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getFrozenColsWidth</span>() + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomLeft</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clipFunc</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">ctx</span>) =&gt;</span> {

        <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,

  }

<ul>
<li>滚动条不需要在讲解了 在之前实现<code>腾讯文档甘特图</code>时已说过实现。定义一个<code>HorizontalBarScrollbar</code>类来测试一下 ， 创建滚动条 ， 并且注册dragmove事件 更新offsetX从而来确定 显示的行列以及 offsetX渲染起点。测试结果</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-title function_">createScrollBars</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { canvas } = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>;

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setupScrollBarEvents</span>();
  }

  public <span class="hljs-title function_">setupScrollBarEvents</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> isDraggingHScroll = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 水平滚动条事件</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"mousedown touchstart"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      isDraggingHScroll = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    });

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"dragmove touchmove"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isDraggingHScroll) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> frozenColsWidth = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">core</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getFrozenColsWidth</span>();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scrollableWidth =
          <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibleWidth</span> - frozenColsWidth - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">config</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollBarSize</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> thumbWidth = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">width</span>();

        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> thumbX = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">x</span>();
        thumbX = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(
          frozenColsWidth,
          <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(thumbX, frozenColsWidth + scrollableWidth - thumbWidth)
        );
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">x</span>(thumbX);
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hScrollThumb</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">y</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibleHeight</span> - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">config</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollBarSize</span> + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 固定Y坐标</span>

        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (scrollableWidth &gt; thumbWidth) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scrollRatio =
            (thumbX - frozenColsWidth) / (scrollableWidth - thumbWidth);
          <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollX</span> = scrollRatio * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">maxScrollX</span>;

      isDraggingHScroll = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
      <span class="hljs-comment">// isDraggingVScroll = false;</span>
    });
</code></pre>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/72834e38cbac443ca3a61233421c8709~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=B9kzLpdnFBZhKGJYtumYwxE1cTw%3D" alt="9c717286ea3fa7ab911323d3c0e871d6.png" width="70%" loading="lazy">
<ul>
<li>这里有两个小点需要注意一下</li>
<li>
<ol>
<li>dragmove的时候我们只需要更新 groupRight 内的行列即可 不需要针对整个画布， 优化渲染。</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<ol start="2">
<li>dragmove会频繁调用render去更新 groupRight内容， 这里需要优化一下</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>通过&nbsp;<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;和队列机制将多个绘制请求合并，确保在同一帧内只执行一次实际的绘制操作，从而避免了不必要的多次渲染，提升了性能</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">private _waitingForDraw = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
  private animQueue = [] <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">Function</span>&gt;;

  public <span class="hljs-title function_">batchDraw</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>();
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">_waitingForDraw</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
      });
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>;
  }

  private <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-params">callback: <span class="hljs-built_in">Function</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(callback);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">req</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> queue = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span>;
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">animQueue</span> = [];
        queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">cb</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-title function_">cb</span>();
        });
      });
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">renderContent</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">core</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">updateScrollBars</span>();
  }
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-18">4.分组的实现 （ <code>难点</code> ）</h4>
<h6 data-id="heading-19">1.前期准备</h6>
<ul>
<li>先来调研一下腾讯文档的 我们就光靠这个效果需要分析出如何实现分组的效果</li>
<li>经过苦思冥想， 想出来两套方案。最终我选择了第二种，因为我对于第二种的思路好打开一点</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  定义好嵌套数据格式
  <span class="hljs-number">1</span> 通过每一个嵌套数据，一组一组的渲染，对于需要结合可视区域渲染来说 稍有难度。
  <span class="hljs-number">2.</span>不要被嵌套给影响 还是一行一行的渲染 ，分组头我也按照行来渲染 只不过需要控制行缩进
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/93f234b61b6d4438b06debc9c0775f37~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=AK2HSYGEh1%2BiZgw0jQEkvLt8A68%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>一组一组的渲染的效果
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4acf6db7ee8c443f950b5e01b32d2429~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=umBF28BB5ZS21YaYUF7hsJtJwrE%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy">
<code>一行一行的渲染 ( 我在使用这种的方案实现的时候 没有经过太多的困难 =&gt; 比较推荐)</code>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9c82921bd5734b0fb5fd5c04b38965b1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=SYv2IYWS6%2FIGiPCfLRt7EdRXw9I%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5 data-id="heading-20">2.定义处理分组的类</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini"> 先定义行存在哪些类型
 export enum CellType {
  <span class="hljs-attr">Record</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Record'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">GroupTab</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'GroupTab'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">AddRow</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'AddRow'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">BlankRow</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'BlankRow'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">Header</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Header'</span>
}

// 处理分组的类
export class LinearRowsManager {
  private linearRows: ILinearRow<span class="hljs-section">[]</span> = <span class="hljs-section">[]</span><span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  private rawData: any<span class="hljs-section">[]</span><span class="hljs-section">[]</span> = <span class="hljs-section">[]</span><span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  private groupConfig: { field: string<span class="hljs-comment">; enabled: boolean } = { field: '', enabled: false };</span>


  private <span class="hljs-attr">groupStates</span> = new Map&lt;string, boolean&gt;()<span class="hljs-comment">; // 保存分组展开状态</span>

  constructor(data: any<span class="hljs-section">[]</span><span class="hljs-section">[]</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-attr">this.rawData</span> = data<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

  // 支持多级分组的构建方法
  buildLinearRows(groupFields?: string<span class="hljs-section">[]</span>): ILinearRow<span class="hljs-section">[]</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attr">this.linearRows</span> = []<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">this.groupConfig</span> = {
      fields: groupFields || <span class="hljs-section">[]</span>,
      enabled: !!(groupFields &amp;&amp; groupFields.length &gt; 0)
    }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>

    // 表头行(始终存在)
    this.linearRows.push({
      type: CellType.Header,
      recordId: 'header-row',
      depth: 0,
      dataIndex: 0,
      displayIndex: 0
    } as ILinearRowHeader)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>

    if (!this.groupConfig.enabled) {
      // 无分组:直接映射所有数据行
      for (let <span class="hljs-attr">i</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1</span><span class="hljs-comment">; i &lt; this.rawData.length; i++) {</span>
        this.linearRows.push({
          type: CellType.Record,
          recordId: `record-${i}`,
          depth: 0,
          dataIndex: i,
          displayIndex: i
        } as ILinearRowRecord)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      }
    } else {
      // 多级分组:递归构建分组树
      this.buildMultiLevelGroups()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    }

    return this.linearRows<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

</code></pre>
<p>class中还定义了一些其他方法</p>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a5c81b5c578e49feae7144d74e182315~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=HHrVqvY%2BPaKmOCSu6hLza7dnVbM%3D" alt="image.png" width="50%" loading="lazy">
<p>经过分组class的处理 我们的数据变成了这样 我们在render中处理的时候就不要处理行列数据了  直接拿这个分组生成的数据来渲染。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e74df628dea34e8abbda1f37239bcd21~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=TOvfcojA6ChJDPb0W54ptGvsbKU%3D" alt="3a0cc61efec6da6d8d8f97056dca5bbc_720.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在render中开启分组 <code>this.enableMultiLevelGrouping(['负责人', '开始时间', '状态']);</code> 看下 groupRight如何渲染的， 核心思维就是要生成 <code>createCell</code></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-comment">// </span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">renderBottomRight</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">time</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renderBottomRight'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> frozenColsWidth = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getFrozenColsWidth</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> frozenRowsHeight = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getFrozenRowsHeight</span>();

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> visibleRows = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getVisibleRowRange</span>(frozenRowsHeight);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">start</span> &gt; visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">end</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeEnd</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renderBottomRight'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> visibleCols = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getVisibleColRange</span>(frozenColsWidth);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (visibleCols.<span class="hljs-property">start</span> &gt; visibleCols.<span class="hljs-property">end</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeEnd</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renderBottomRight'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 先绘制背景</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">renderLevel1GroupBackgrounds</span>(visibleRows, frozenColsWidth, frozenRowsHeight, <span class="hljs-string">'bottomRight'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">renderLevel2GroupBackgrounds</span>(visibleRows, frozenColsWidth, frozenRowsHeight, <span class="hljs-string">'bottomRight'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> colPositions = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">preCalculateColPositions</span>(visibleCols, frozenColsWidth);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> currentY = frozenRowsHeight - <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollY</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> row = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">frozenRows</span>; row &lt; visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">start</span>; row++) {
      currentY += <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowHeight</span>(row);
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> row = visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">start</span>; row &lt;= visibleRows.<span class="hljs-property">end</span>; row++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> height = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRowHeight</span>(row);

      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, col = visibleCols.<span class="hljs-property">start</span>; col &lt;= visibleCols.<span class="hljs-property">end</span>; col++, i++) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getColumnWidth</span>(col);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> x = colPositions[i];

        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cell = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createCell</span>(row, col, x, currentY, width, height);
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomRight</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(cell);
      }

      currentY += height;
    }

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeEnd</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renderBottomRight'</span>);
  }
</code></pre>
<p>设定一个createCell函数 你要返回一个正确的 cell group出来，需要处理 枚举的五种类型的渲染方式。
五种类型的渲染方式各有不同 我们可以通过布局思想来定义一下，分别处理渲染。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"> <span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> enum <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Record'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">GroupTab</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'GroupTab'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">AddRow</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'AddRow'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">BlankRow</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'BlankRow'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Header</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Header'</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>先定义一个基类</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> abstract <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellLayout</span> {
  protected <span class="hljs-attr">ctx</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">CanvasRenderingContext2D</span>;
  protected <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: number = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  protected <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: number = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  protected <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: number = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  protected <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: number = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

  <span class="hljs-title function_">setPosition</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> = x;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> = y;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = width;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = height;
  }

  abstract <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">row</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ILinearRow</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">col</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">isFirstCol</span>: boolean, <span class="hljs-attr">isLastCol</span>: boolean): <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>后续五种行布局也需要定义出来</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f1d43b034790424386cc669fe6f1a02d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=jw7sQ2qaP%2BCu6Xe6AqWYLk20LAE%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>以分组行布局来举例。 主要是处理分组行的缩进 以及折叠的事件 后续还要扩展 统计之类的功能。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">GroupTabLayout</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">CellLayout</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">row</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ILinearRow</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">col</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">isFirstCol</span>: boolean, <span class="hljs-attr">isLastCol</span>: boolean): <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> group = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> });
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> groupRow = row <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ILinearRowGroup</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> depth = row.<span class="hljs-property">depth</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bgColor = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getGroupBackground</span>(depth);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> indentOffset = depth * <span class="hljs-number">20</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 根据层级缩进</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isFirstCol) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 第一列:展开/折叠图标和分组标题</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bgRect = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: indentOffset,
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> - indentOffset,
        <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: bgColor,
        <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#e0e0e0'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>
      });

      <span class="hljs-comment">// 只有非最后一层的分组才显示展开/折叠图标</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> showExpandIcon = groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">children</span> &amp;&amp; groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">children</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">some</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">child</span> =&gt;</span>
        child.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">GroupTab</span>
      );

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> icon = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Text</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: indentOffset + <span class="hljs-number">15</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: showExpandIcon ? (groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">expanded</span> ? <span class="hljs-string">'▼'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'▶'</span>) : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">8</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#4a5568'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">listening</span>: showExpandIcon
      });

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> titleText = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Text</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: indentOffset + (showExpandIcon ? <span class="hljs-number">30</span> : <span class="hljs-number">15</span>),
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> - <span class="hljs-number">5</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${groupRow.groupTitle}</span> (<span class="hljs-subst">${groupRow.recordCount}</span>)`</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">8</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#2d3748'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontWeight</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'bold'</span>
      });

      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (showExpandIcon) {
        bgRect.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
          bgRect.<span class="hljs-title function_">fire</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'toggleGroup'</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">groupId</span>: groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">groupId</span> });
        });
        icon.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
          icon.<span class="hljs-title function_">fire</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'toggleGroup'</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">groupId</span>: groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">groupId</span> });
        });
      }

      group.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(bgRect, icon, titleText);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (col === <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 第二列:分组字段信息</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bgRect = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: bgColor,
        <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#e0e0e0'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>
      });

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fieldLabel = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Text</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-number">10</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-number">6</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.getGroupFieldLabel(depth)}</span>: <span class="hljs-subst">${groupRow.groupField}</span>`</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">7</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#718096'</span>
      });

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> valueLabel = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Text</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-number">10</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: groupRow.<span class="hljs-property">groupTitle</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">13</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fontWeight</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'bold'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#2d3748'</span>
      });

      group.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(bgRect, fieldLabel);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 其他列:空背景</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bgRect = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: bgColor,
        <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#e0e0e0'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>
      });
      group.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(bgRect);
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> group;
  }

  private <span class="hljs-title function_">getGroupBackground</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">depth</span>: number): string {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// const colors = ['#f7fafc', '#edf2f7', '#e2e8f0', '#cbd5e0'];</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> colors = [<span class="hljs-string">'#FFF'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'#F5F5F5'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'#FFF'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'#cbd5e0'</span>];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> colors[<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(depth, colors.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)];
  }

  private <span class="hljs-title function_">getGroupFieldLabel</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">depth</span>: number): string {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> labels = [<span class="hljs-string">'一级分组'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'二级分组'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'三级分组'</span>];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> labels[<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(depth, labels.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)] || <span class="hljs-string">'分组'</span>;
  }

}
</code></pre>
<p>全部定义好了 全部在 render类中实例化</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">linearRowsManager</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LinearRowsManager</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">linearRowsManager</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">buildLinearRows</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始无分组</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化布局渲染器</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groupTabLayout</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">GroupTabLayout</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">recordRowLayout</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RecordRowLayout</span>(
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>,
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">colsConfig</span>
    );
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">addRowLayout</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AddRowLayout</span>(); 
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">blankRowLayout</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BlankRowLayout</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">headerLayout</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">headerLayout</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">iconManager</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">columns</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>正确处理后 生成单元格</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-title function_">createCell</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">rowIndex</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">col</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: number, <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: number): <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> row = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">linearRowsManager</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getRow</span>(rowIndex);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!row) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>();

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isFirstCol = col === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> headerRow = rowIndex === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isLastCol = col === <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cols</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">layout</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">CellLayout</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">switch</span> (row.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">GroupTab</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groupTabLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">AddRow</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">addRowLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">BlankRow</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">blankRowLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Header</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">headerLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Record</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">recordRowLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>:
        layout = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">recordRowLayout</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
    }

    layout.<span class="hljs-title function_">setPosition</span>(x, y, width, height);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cellGroup = layout.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(row, col, isFirstCol, isLastCol);

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听分组折叠事件</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (row.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">GroupTab</span>) {
      cellGroup.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'toggleGroup'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e: any</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">linearRowsManager</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggleGroup</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">groupId</span>);
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>();
      });
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听 AddRow 点击事件</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (row.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-title class_">CellType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">AddRow</span>) {
      cellGroup.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'addRow'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e: any</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">handleAddRow</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">groupId</span>);
      });
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cellGroup;
  }

</code></pre>

<h3 data-id="heading-21">七、性能优化</h3>
<ul>
<li>cell单元格的值： 可能会在公式 引用之类的大数据量计算，这里我使用web worker。</li>
<li>数据统计和筛选，排序，查找这些使用 异步分片来实现。</li>
<li>多维表格中的 icon及image的缓存与复用等等...</li>
</ul>
<p>example：在单元格渲染时计算复杂计算时 使用web worker来计算 然后<code>textNode.text(result)</code>实现单个单元格更新</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"> <span class="hljs-comment">// cacl(40)</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (textContext &amp;&amp; textContext.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'cacl'</span>)) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">alloyWorker</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cookie</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">exportStaion</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">10</span> &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">5</span> ? <span class="hljs-number">40</span> : <span class="hljs-number">39</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">result</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> groups = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groups</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomRight</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">find</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`#<span class="hljs-subst">${row}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${col}</span>`</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Group</span>[];
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (groups.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> textNode = groups[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>].<span class="hljs-property">children</span>[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Text</span>;
          textNode.<span class="hljs-title function_">text</span>(result);
        }
      })
      textContext = <span class="hljs-string">'计算中...'</span>;
    }
</code></pre>
<p>统计之类的使用异步分片 ，可以动态控制fps的变化 来控制处理数据量 。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e0eb9447fbf5478a9c149aac059b5e1d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=%2FSjpLncZHtBvzSqlH7K97yeJD%2Bg%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-22">八、扩展性</h3>
<p>还有很多需要继续去实现和扩展，高亮 选区 列类型生成不同的单元格 等等...</p>
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/411824c76aaa4bb68135112ee73c92b8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=WPFouNX7CWJK4lGeGU8GSsLBycw%3D" alt="image.png" width="30%" loading="lazy">
<p>再举个扩展的例子：<code>用户选区</code></p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/809e764dd15742ee8fe42b92b84727b1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54Ot5b-D5biC5rCR5bCP5bKz:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765849722&amp;x-signature=%2Fif2xZ2bzXT%2FUAlhgfBWx29KoPM%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>实现起来也很简单</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SelectionNodeManager</span> {

  public <span class="hljs-attr">selectionBorder</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Rect</span>;

  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fillConfig = {
      <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.1)"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">listening</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>, 
    };

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">topRect</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>(fillConfig);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">rightRect</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>(fillConfig);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomRect</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>(fillConfig);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">leftRect</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>(fillConfig);

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selectionBorder</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ThinBorderRect</span>({

      <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">listening</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
    }) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> any;

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">activeCellBorder</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Konva</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Rect</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"transparent"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"#1e6fff"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">strokeWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">listening</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
    });
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{
    selectionX,
    selectionY,
    selectionWidth,
    selectionHeight,
    activeCellX,
    activeCellY,
    activeCellWidth,
    activeCellHeight
  }</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算相对位置</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> relX = activeCellX - selectionX;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> relY = activeCellY - selectionY;

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 上方区域</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">topRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: selectionX,
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: selectionY,
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: selectionWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: relY,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: relY &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 右侧区域</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rightWidth = selectionWidth - (relX + activeCellWidth);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">rightRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: activeCellX + activeCellWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: activeCellY,
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: rightWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: activeCellHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: rightWidth &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 下方区域</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bottomHeight = selectionHeight - (relY + activeCellHeight);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: selectionX,
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: activeCellY + activeCellHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: selectionWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: bottomHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: bottomHeight &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 左侧区域</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">leftRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: selectionX,
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: activeCellY,
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: relX,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: activeCellHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: relX &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 5. 整体边框</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selectionBorder</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: selectionX,
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: selectionY,
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: selectionWidth,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: selectionHeight,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 6. 活动单元格边框</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">activeCellBorder</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttrs</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: activeCellX  + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,

      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: activeCellWidth - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: activeCellHeight - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">visible</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    });
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">topRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">rightRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bottomRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">leftRect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selectionBorder</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">activeCellBorder</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">visible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  }
}

<p>生成选区节点 监听事件并且更新选区即可。还有一个边界就不细说了</p>

<h3 data-id="heading-23">结语</h3>
<p>存在疑问的可以留言，还有许多功能需要开发 打磨，有进展了再发文章。 这篇文章主要帮大家打开思路， 一步一步的解决一个困难功能的实现。</p></div></div>
